messages:
Maya: heads-up: I'm kicking off an async preview for `cfg.routing.load_shed.strategy` on staging in ~10m. goal: measure impact without changing runtime enforcement.
Oren: preview-only ok. what strategy are we shadowing?
Maya: switching from `drop_random` -> `priority_queue_smooth`. runtime will evaluate and emit a preview snapshot + diffs, not apply.
Felix: please make the preview API return 202 + `preview_id` (instead of 200). SDKs keep assuming sync and we waste threads. add `estimated_propagation_ms` and `affected_shards` in the 202 payload.
Maya: yep, preview apply -> 202 {preview_id, estimated_propagation_ms, preview_size_estimate}. status endpoint `/previews/{id}` returns {state, affected_shards, ready_at}.
Samir: telemetry: avoid tenant labels. emit cohort-level metrics like `load_shed.preview_risk{cohort="c-blue"}` and a sampled evidence stream `load_shed.preview_samples` at default 1/250. sampled events go to secure-logs with salted one-way hashed tenant.
Oren: instead of per-tenant metrics, expose per-shard boolean gauges `load_shed.preview_alert{shard="sh-9"}` and a sampled event for the tenant id when the gauge flips. keeps cardinality low.
Felix: console UX: show a collapsible side-by-side summary (current vs preview aggregates: p50/p95 lat, drop_rate, qps) + an "Inspect evidence" drawer with redacted sampled events. add an "Export evidence" action to zip snapshot + traces + replay CSV.
Maya: ACK modal will show: preview_id, git sha, who started preview, human bullets of changes, and an explicit two-check confirmation if auto-pause thresholds are elevated. ACK returns `audit_token` used for any apply/rollback.
Samir: runbook: auto-pause preview if `load_shed.preview_risk` increases by >2% absolute for any cohort OR if `load_shed.preview_alert` fires twice in 12m. auto-pause creates an incident draft with the preview snapshot attached and top 20 sampled events.
Oren: add an ops-bot action `ops-bot pause-preview {preview_id}` that records the pauser, reason, and snapshot link. and a resume requires 2-person ACK with `audit_token`.
Felix: replay job: persist preview snapshot + sampled traces to S3 for 28d. deterministic replay will run against prev/new logic and produce a small CSV per preview_id: cpu_ms, avg_tokens, op_delta. Optimize will consume it. queue replay off-peak by default.
Maya: security: sampled tenant hashes must be salted per-tenant-seed + one-way SHA256 before leaving runtime. add that to the PR checklist.
Samir: sampling rate should be runtime-configurable and exposed in Dedicated/Private builds. default 1/250 but ops can ramp for small cohorts. expose a UI slider with caps to prevent costly ramps.
Oren: API note: make preview apply idempotent and return same preview_id if duplicate requests contain same config sha + actor. prevents accidental double-previews.
Felix: small implementation nit: in the preview status response, include `preview_size_estimate` (approx affected keys) and `preview_snapshot_s3_url` (signed short-lived) so Console can fetch diffs without hitting internal APIs.
Maya: agree. will include signed url TTL=5min. also adding a compact timeline widget in Console (start, auto-pause events, ACKs, replay completed).
Samir: alerting: wire `load_shed.preview_alert` to a low-noise pager rule: only page if (alert_count>3 && cohort_delta>2%) within 15m. otherwise email to owners.
Oren: please add a small CLI for devs to fetch preview evidence: `redwood preview fetch <preview_id> --s3` which downloads the zip. include in the PR docs.
Felix: good. tag me on the API + console PRs so I can review schema and link formatting.
preview-bot: preview-created by maya/load-shed-preview  diff: 7 files changed  http://ci.redwood/internal/12121
Maya: launching preview in 10. tagging infra + console + oncall. I'll push PRs for 202 semantics, sampling knobs, and runbook in next hour.
Oren: thanks. pls add the exact metric names and shard label conventions in the PR so SRE can wire alerts.
Samir: and add an integration test that validates preview apply returns 202 and status goes to ready within `estimated_propagation_ms` +/- 20%. reduces flakiness.
Maya: will add tests. launching in 8. :rocket:
